scorecard.venue: Dr. Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b RS Bopara

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b KV Sharma

balls.text: very full and on middle, Reddy backs away and hacks it between deep midwicket and long-on. Smith runs across from deep midwicket and hunts the ball down
banged in short and just outside off, half pulled and half slogged in front of Hooda at deep backward square
Reddy backs away miles outside leg, Southee follows him. Jammed out to mid-off
banged in short and directed at the body, top-edged pull that bounces in front of deep square leg
bumper from Southee, Reddy is beaten on the hook. Good presence of mind from Bopara as they sneak in a leg bye

slower fullish ball on off, Reddy waits for it, picks it up and lofts it high into the air. Faulkner runs across to his from long-off, goes as far as he can on the long-off boundary, leaps, takes the catch and goes over the rope. The result is a six
fullish and outside off, driven hard, Smith dives to his right at extra cover and makes a sharp stop
quicker outside off, drilled past covers

Ashish Reddy is in trouble, the bat got twisted up in the air. He may have just grounded the bat before the bails came off the groove. Fraction short and outside off, cut away past cover. The man at long-off moves to his left and lasers a throw to the bowler's end. Reddy scampers across, slides, the bat popped up momentarily, but he is in. The TV umpire confirms it
this was fuller and on off, Bopara gets under it, frees his arms and launches it over long-on. That's a monster blow, sends it flying into the stands
slid through outside off, left alone
knocked to the leg side for a single
slower back of a length ball outside off, cut to backward point
very full and on the stumps, he drives it down the track and beats mid-off
on a length and outside off, pushed to the covers
dug in short and outside off as Bopara advances, gets a bottom-edge that whizzes past the stumps
Morris spills a return catch. Bopara comes down the track, Morris drags his length back to ruin Bopara's pull. Mistimed back to the bowler, he moves to his right, but it does not stick
good length ball around off, dabbed softly in front of the covers
quicker outside off, cut in front of square on the off side
he finds the gap now and crashes it past the covers to open his account
slid through, forced to covers
Tambe gets his man now. He is elated and his hands aloft in joy. This one skids off the deck on middle, might have been a flipper. Morgan misses the reverse sweep and the umpire raises his forefinger

Sanju fluffs a stumping. Tambe gets this to drift in, Morgan strays out of the crease as he wants to drive through the off side but he misses. Sanju is beaten as well, the extra bounce foxes him. He can't collect the ball and whip the bails off and effect a stumping
fuller and on middle and leg, knocked through vacant midwicket. Bopara wants two but has to settle with one
Bopara works it in front of square on the leg side for a single
on the leg stump, nudged in front of midwicket
flat and outside off, squeezed to the covers
dug in shortish, Morgan looks to pull, skews it back to the bowler off the bottom part of the bat
pushed through on the stumps, driven down the track, past Hooda, who was diving to his right
tossed up outside off, top-edges the reverse sweep over the left of the keeper
flatter and quicker, blocked out to the leg side, Tambe runs to his left and hunts it down
Morgan goes for a reverse-sweep against a googly, gets a bottom-edge just wide of Smith at slip. Smith anticipated, moved away to his left, aims to belatedly intercept with his right boot in vain
fuller and outside off, driven through the off side
punched back at the bowler, diving save from Tambe
pushed through on off, defended
that's a top ball from Tambe, he lets out a big roar. This tossed up ball pitches outside leg and spins past the bat and hits the middle stump. Ojha is crease-bound as he looks to flick and misses.
change of pace, short ball outside off. Morgan waits for it to arrive and rifles a cut behind point, raced away to the fence
dug in short, he rocks back and plays a controlled pull towards long leg
fuller and angled in on middle, slapped to the left of vacant mid-on. There is protection in the deep though
back of a length and outside off, open-faced punch to point
back of a length and hurries on outside off, beaten on the cut
banged in short, Morgan splices the pull in front of long-on
skids off the deck on off, short in length, cut straight to point

tossed up from Tambe, Ojha goes over the covers after stepping out. The fielder from the deep rushes in, dives forward, but lets the sliced ball through his hands. Tough chance, that. He dived full-length to his right, but only parried it away with his fingertips
shortish and outside off, he is beaten on the cut
fuller and on the stumps, driven down the track
pushed through does not spin much, he wears it on the pad
what.a.a.ball from Tambe, simply unplayable. Pitched on the leg stump and rips across Ojha, misses the off stump by a whisker
Binny delivers a half-tracker outside off, he does not have enough pace to threaten Morgan. He pulls it firmly over backward square
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, forced through the covers
length delivery on middle, Morgan lifts it over mid-off. Not well-timed, though
dug in short and on middle and leg, Morgan blocks it in front of the bowler
fuller and outside off, driven past the covers to sweeper
fuller and outside off, Morgan charges down the track and crunches it to sweeper cover
too leg-stumpish from Faulkner, stray ball and duly eased away fine on the leg side
angled onto the pads, nudged behind square leg
Faulkner bangs a bouncer outside off, Morgan jerks his head out of the way and lets it fly to Sanju
back of a length and on the hips, he can't flick it away. The ball rolls away to leg, Ojha wants a single but is sent back
Morgan has banished that over deep midwicket, into the stands. Short and sits up outside off, Morgan fetches it from there and swat-pulls it over the boundary

Faulkner gets rid of Ojha. Oh no, no, no, thats a no-ball.. Looks his his footing is on the line. No part of his heel behind the crease. Ojha gets a lifeline. This was dug in short and climbs onto Ojha, who gets into an awkward tangle as he attempts a pull. He can only lob it into the air off a top-edge. Sanju moves to his left and grasps it. The TV umpire examines from various angles and gives it NOT OUT. Faulkner can't believe it and so can't Steve Smith
back of a length and angles across off, the extra lift on that bests Ojha's attempted cut
slipper short ball from Binny, Morgan shifs his balance to the back foot and controls a pull to deep midwicket
Morgan skips out and yorks himself, jabbed to short cover
fuller and straighter, he manoeuvres it in front of square on the leg side
beauty from Binny! Probing back of a length ball, kicks up from a length and seams in, past the groping bat of Ojha. That was too good even to kiss the edge
fuller and on middle and leg, Morgan nurdles a single through square leg
good length ball moves away with the angle outside off, Morgan lets it be
back-of-the-hand slower ball and Faulkner has a propensity to generate extra bounce. Cuts back in sharply as well. Ojha spars at it, the ball grazes the glove and rolls to the leg side
clipped off the hips to the left of short midwicket
back of a length and on middle and leg, turned in front of mid-on for a hustled single
bumper from Faulkner, Ojha sinks under it. Wide called
Faulkner errs too full and straight, that is in the glancing radar of Ojha. Helped away fine, beats the fielder's slide in the deep
back of a length and on the hips, tucked in front of square on the leg side
back of a length, Morgan yanks his bottom hand off the bat and defends it
good length delivery on off, he gets right behind the line in defence and half-waves the bat to Morgan
dug in shortish and climbs on off, he gets on top of the bounce and quells it in front of point
bumper from Kulkarni, the batsman ducks under it. Wided, for there was too much height on it
pitched up and tails back in sharply, Ojha seeks to drive and gets an inside edge onto the pad
back of a length and on the hips, tucked behind square on the leg side
back of a length and outside off, he hops up and punches it softly to the covers and takes off to the other end
good length ball on off, draws Ojha into a forward defensive push back to the bowler
back of a length and on middle and leg, clipped towards deep midwicket. Binny runs in from there and keeps it to a single
near yorker swings in, squeezed to square leg. There is a communication breakdown between the wickets but no harm done for SRH

whoa! Pitched up with some away movement outside off, he offers a mere extension of a push. Whistles away to the left of short cover. This was by no means a half-volley, the timing was right out of the top draw
short and hurries on top of off, he hops up and drops it in front of the covers
banged in short and lifts outside off, Ojha is beaten on the cut
back of a length, he hops up and defends it back to the bowler
good length ball angled across off, left alone by Morgan. Top maiden from Kulkarni
shortish and angled across, Morgan mishits the pull towards midwicket
Morgan jumps down the track, Dhawal drags his length back and angles it across the left-hander. Morgan has a waft at it and is beaten
back of a length and on middle, blocked back to the bowler
on a good length and swings in, Morgan gets a thick inside edge onto the pad to avert the hat-trick

Twin strike from the Royals, Kulkarni on a hattrick. SRH have been reduced to 35 for 3 . This was fuller jags in and on middle, Rahul seeks to flick it across the line but misses his stroke, he is struck on the pad, well below the knee roll. Rahul was crease-bound there and pays the penalty That would have smacked into middle and leg and given!

Sharp work from Rahane at backward point. He nails the stumps at the striker's. Southee nips this one back into Rahul after going wide of the crease. Rahul does not meet with the flick, the ball wanders away behind point.  The pair want to sneak in a leg bye. Rahane moves quickly to his left, collects the ball and flings an accurate throw at the strikers'. Warner is well short
back of a length and outside off, sort of stops on Rahul, who checks his stroke and punches it to the left of the covers
on a good length and outside off, Rahul comes forward and presses it to the covers
pitched further up and swings in on off, Rahul inches forward and blocks it back to the bowler
on a length and on middle and off, driven towards deep cover
low full toss down leg, Warner does not put it away with a glance
dug in short and on middle, Warner backs away and cuts it over point. Upper cut and Warner deposits it into the stands

And Kulkarni strikes, good retort. This one rears up from a back of a length and slides across Dhawan with the angle. He has a loose waft at it and edges it through to Sanju, who moves to his left to pouch that.
Dhawan nips down the track, this is on a length and outside off. Plenty of width on offer and Dhawan thrashes it up and over the covers
back of a length cutter, around off, Warner stays back, waits on it and punches it to Rahane at point via an open face. He scampers across for a single
follows up the shorter one with a canny slower ball. Warner is early into the lash and is beaten again, this time by the change-up
back of a length and sliding across Warner, who sets up for a massive pull but the angle takes it away from him and he ends up beaten
fuller and wider outside off, Dhawan does not bother much about feet movement and toe-ends a drive to the right of mid-off
Warner steps away, Hooda drags it short and gets it to skid on, Warner miscues the cut back to the bowler. He did not have enough width to free his arms
tossed up outside off and drifts in, Dhawan wants to drive after stepping out, off the inner part of the bat towards mid-on
darted down leg, Dhawan lets it be, wided
slid through on middle, Dhawan steps away and cuts it to point
Dhawan latches onto this! He comes down the track, manufactures a full toss and whips it in the gap between midwicket and mid-on
drifts in on middle, defended off the back foot
shortish and angles it to the left-hander, cut to point, straight to the fielder
back of a length and hurries on close to off, Warner can only chop it weakly to the covers
Morris reverts to the shorter side, he is cramped for room. Mishits the cut to backward point
half-volley outside off, Warner opens the face of his bat and drives it past backward point
change of pace from Morris, stops on the batsman. Warner is aware of it as he check-taps it gently to mid-off
half-track outside off, Warner cuts it fiercely through cover-point. It blazes away to the boundary
short and angling away outside off, Warner has a crack at it and pulls it over a leaping mid-on. Not middled, he just about cleared the fielder. Replays reveal that the fielder finger-tipped it over

outside edge is drawn by Southee, dies in front of Steven Smith at a wide-ish first slip. Dhawan skips out, Southee pushes this across the batsman, who gets a thick outside edge. Does not carry to Smith, the TV umpire confirms it as well. He dives across to his left, the ball lands in front of Smith.
inswinging yorker on the leg stump, he jabs his bat down and manages an inside edge onto the pad
much fuller and hurled across off, Dhawan drives with a bent knee, fails to connect with the drive
pitched up and Southee sustains the movement to mess with Dhawan's attempted drive. He has to settle with an inside edge which trickles towards mid-on
Southee swings this one in on the pads, too full and that's clipped away behind square on the leg side
Southee greets Warner with a  bumpy short ball outside off. Warner is a smidge late onto the pull, gets a bottom-edge that rolls towards point

Faulkner the finisher does it for Rajasthan.. PK aims for the yorker, ventures too full, so much so that it ends up as a full toss. Carved away between covers and backward point, skips away to the cover-point boundary. That's the winning blow and PK is cross with himself. Four wins in four games for the Royals
very full and on off, Binny advances and drills it down to long-off

low full toss on the leg stump, Faulkner wants to go sweep it to the leg side. Off the pad and runs away to third man. This was snaking down leg and the leg-before appeal amounts to nothing. They sneak a single via leg bye
yorker length ball, right in the blockhole outside off, Faulkner backs away, throws his bat at it and misses

full and wide outside off, Binny flashes it towards backward point, who dives to his left and makes a superb stop. Morgan then has a shy at the non-strikers' and misses. A direct hit could have consumed Binny. Perhaps, PK should have backed that up, Bopara comes in from mid-on and also fumbles, failing to collect the throw properly
yorker at the base of the leg stump at 124ks, Faulkner gets an inside edge onto the pad after stepping away
banged in short and outside off, it gets big on Binny. He initially loaded up for the pull but managed to slice it up and over backward point
back of a length and outside off, he advances down the track and flat-bats it to cover, diving save from the fielder

Boult takes out Rahane, the latter throws his head back in disappointment. This was on a back of a length and on off, Rahane backs away and wants to slog it over the leg side. He can only drag it back onto the off stump off a bottom edge
banged in short and outside off, Binny has to fetch the pull from there. Miscues it in front of deep midwicket
back of a length and outside off, Binny wants to smash it through the off side, but makes no contact
shortish and outside off, mis-hit pull to long-on. Rahane did not middle it as well as would have liked to
lowish full toss on off, flicked away to midwicket. Should have been dispatched to the boundary
yorker on middle as he backs away, squeezed out past a diving point
fuller and around off, Rahane slaps it over Bhuvi. Warner races across to his right from long-off and limits it to a single
impressive strike from Rahane. Back of a length and on middle, Rahane takes the aerial route and wristily pulls it with the angle over midwicket
fired full and outside off, jabbed in front of point
back of a length and on the hips, chipped over midwicket for one
Binny opens the face of the bat on impact with this length delivery on off, steers it to left of deep third man
slower shortish ball, pulled away in front of square leg
back of a length outside off, change of pace. He waits on it and chops it to the right of the keeper via a bottom edge
pitched up and outside off, drilled back to the bowler
very, very wristy! Rahane nips down the track, manufactures a length ball and flicks it over wide mid-on
fuller and on off, Binny looks to flick it over the leg side, gets a leading edge that flies over cover-point. There is protection in the deep
shortish and outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover
fifty for Rahane, back of a length and comes in on middle, worked to the right of midwicket
on a length and outside off, another one sticks in the pitch and stops on Rahane. He checks his push and plays it to short cover
fuller and cuts back in off the seam on off, pushed down through mid-off
back of a length, punchily blocked back to the bowler
back of a length and on the hips, picked away behind square on the leg side
back of a length and outside off, Rahane stands tall and cuts it away to the right of deep third man. Peachy timing
back of a length and outside off, steered away to deep third man

how soft is that? Chipped back at the bowler. Good length ball outside off, stops on the batsman. Karn aims to flick it away, instead he lobs it back to Bopara, who moves to his right and snags the catch
good length outside off, pushed to mid-off
gentle dibbly-dobbler outside off, driven back at the bowler
full and outside off, Rahane drives it crisply to long-on
Nair blocks this flighted ball on off
fuller and on middle, straight roller, flipped with the wrists through midwicket
Rahane nails the gap now. Overpitched outside off, Rahane bends his knee and creams a drive to the left of Warner, who was diving to his left at short cover. She whistles away to the boundary
back of a length and outside off, cut away to sweeper cover
Smith picks out Warner at short cover. Karn flights this outside off, Smith goes hard on the drive but cracks it straight to Warner
tossed up on middle, he uses his feet, hits it with the turn and lofts it inside-out over mid-off
back of a length on off, mistimed punch to deep backward square, good enough for a single, though
very full on off, whippily driven to long-on and he snatches the Orange Cap from Warner
slower offering on off, Rahane comes forward and nudges it in front of short midwicket
pitched up and on off, Rahane comes forward and pats it back to the bowler
full on middle and leg, turned to mid-on
Smith advances and yorks himself, dug out to the covers
squeezed down to third man
crude slog, but its effective. Length on off, Smith cleans his front leg and mauls it away to the long-on boundary
back of a length and climbs outside off, Smith looks for the cut but the ball bounces over the blade. Nice, TV-friendly carry to the keeper
fullish and outside off, driven to the left of the covers
back of a length and angled outside off, Rahane moves deep in the crease and cuts it up and over point for the first four in 27 balls
fuller and curls in around off, Smith shuffles across and gets an inside-edge to the leg side
well-directed bouncer to Smith, he sways his head out of the way
back of a length and outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it with his feet in cement and gets beaten
back of a length and wobbles away outside off, he wants to punch it on the up and through the covers but is beaten by the extra zip there
floated up outside off, pushed to the left of Bopara
fuller and on off, Smith has a shimmy across the crease and nudges it through midwicket

Bopara delivers the breakthrough. Samson has given it away. Fuller and outside off, Samson opens his bat-face and looks to steer through vacant slip. His opposite number - Ojha - dives to his right and plucks a smart one-handed catch. The umpire check for a no-ball, Bopara is okay, the catch is also clean. Samson departs for 26 off 30
fuller and on off and middle, wristed through vacant midwicket for a jogged single
dragged short and wide outside off, Rahane rocks back and pulls it convincingly to cow corner. Boult runs to his right from long-on and limits it to one
fuller on off, turned through vacant midwicket. The pair take two by the time Karn runs across and gets to the ball
floated on off, pushed to the covers
peachy legbreak, leaves Rahane and prodding and missing
tossed up and very full outside off, drilled through the cover region. Sweeper moves to his right and stops the ball
flatter and on middle and leg, whipped away to long-on
back of a length and swerves in just outside off, Sanju whips it over midwicket, bringing his wrists into play, again
back of a length and outside off, dabbed in front of point. Rahane wants a single but is sent back
Sanju shuffles across and flicks it uppishly over backward square
back of a length and outside off, the bat twists in Sanju's hand as he punches it down to short midwicket
dug in shortish and outside off, Samson controls a pull and directs it backward of square leg
back of a length and outside off, half paddled and half pulled through midwicket
aha, sharp spin. Karn lands this outside off and gets it to rip across further, Samson is not lured into sparring at it
looks like a googly, spins in on off, milked behind square leg for one
tossed up outside off, guided to backward point. Rahane wants a single but is sent back
slid through short on middle and leg, top spinner, whipped away through midwicket
shortish and on middle, mistimed pull in front of long-on
looped up nicely on off, blocked from the crease
on a good length and around off, dabbed in front of point
fuller and swings away outside off, squares up Samson, who gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon
Reddy drops a tough chance. Back of a length again, outside off. Sanju short-arm pulls it in the air. Reddy rushes in from deep midwicket, dives forward and lets it slip through his hands
back of a length and outside off, this time he makes a decent connection. Samson shuffles across and clubs it in the air, to the right of mid-on
swing and a miss to a back of a length ball outside off, wobbles away late
on a length and outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it and slices it to deep third man off a thick outside edge
mis-directs a bouncer down leg, wide called
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped to mid-on, straight to the fielder
full and outside off, laced past the covers
pitched up and swinging away outside off ignored. Ojha does not glove the ball cleanly and concedes a bye

Rahane just clears mid-on. Length ball outside off, Rahane looks to flick it away, instead chips it in the air. The man at mid-off runs to his left, leaps but the ball loops over him. I think Boult was the fielder there
fuller and outside off, driven to the left of short cover for one
fuller and outside off, bunted to the off side
on a good length and outside off, Sanju steps out and pushes it to mid-off
fuller and tails in around off, Sanju tips forward and defends it back to PK
back of a length and on off, whipped away in front of square on the leg side
pitched up and moves in a bit just outside off, dropped in front of point
angled in on off on a good-ish length, worked in front of short midwicket for a speedy single
fuller and outside off, Samson presses forward and drives it between mid-off and cover
on a length, PK hunts for some inswing and drifts it down leg. Samson can't glance it away
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped away fine on the leg side. Long leg runs to his right now, but ends up beaten
fuller and swings away outside off, Rahane chases it with a weak drive and is beaten
drifting onto the pads, Rahane twirls his wrists and eases it behind square on the leg side. Long leg runs to his left and mops it up
near yorker on off, Rahane jams it out to mid-off
back of a length and down leg, Rahane can't glance it away. The swing takes it down leg and is wided
good length around off, knocked in front of mid-off for a scampered single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end and misses
good length ball angling away outside off, mistimed drive back to Boult
fuller and skiddy just outside off, dead-batted in front of point
pitched up and swings in on off, Sanju does not account for the inward movement, manages an inside-edge to the right of mid-on
very full and outside off, driven smoothly to point
this one kicks up from a length outside off, Sanju aims to dink it away towards deep third man but is beaten
fuller and outside off, he leans forward and drives it in the gap between point and the covers
good length ball outside off, Sanju comes forward and defends it stoutly to the covers
angled in fuller and on middle, Rahane shuffles across off and blocks it to short midwicket
blocked in front of point

a big shout for lbw from Boult, but the umpire turns it down. Pitched up and swings in on middle, Rahane misses the across-the-line flick, gets beaten on the inside edge and is rapped on the front pad. That was plumb lbw
pitched up and on off, he angles his bat and dabs it in front of point
swerving on the pads again, Rahane helps it away fine on the leg side to the left of the keeper
swinging in on the hips, he misses the flick, they sneak a leg bye
inswinger from Bhuvi, Rahane's feet does not move as he pokes at it. Squirts it to the leg side
shortish and outside off, Rahane camps on the back foot and cuts it strongly to the left of backward point
pitched up and swinging away outside off, Sanju slices a drive to deep third man
back of a length, width on offer outside off, flashed into the covers. Sanju misses out on that
fuller and comes in outside off, Sanju aims to drive, gets an inside edge that dribbles to the leg side
fullish with a hint of away swing outside off, Rahane employs soft hands and dabs it behind point
